scope: GB-T0.02.02.T1 (#16). Exceptions cover only review-required licenses, pinned by exact name, version and license string. They never cover prohibited or missing licenses. The three exceptions were decided by the coordinator on 2026-11-16 under delegated section authority, as ordinary dependency-policy decisions; no human owner approval is recorded or implied. Scope is the research-only canvas fixture (research-fixtures/canvas, not part of product distribution). This is not legal sign-off; re-review is required before any product distribution. Verified license overrides (verified_license_overrides) supply a license only for a lockfile entry with no license field whose name, exact version and integrity all match. Each override records evidence obtained outside the offline gate; it is not legal sign-off and cannot cover prohibited licenses.

exceptions.name: dompurify
exceptions.reason: Dual-licensed (MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0). The checker's conservative OR rule does not select a branch, so the expression is review-required. Decided by the coordinator on 2026-11-16 under delegated section authority: the Apache-2.0 branch is elected and relied on, Apache-2.0 notices are retained, and the MPL-2.0 branch is not relied on. Reached from research-fixtures/canvas (no dev flag in the lockfile). Scope: research-only canvas fixture, not part of product distribution. This is not legal sign-off; re-review is required before any product distribution.

exceptions.name: pako
exceptions.reason: Conjunctive expression (MIT AND Zlib): both terms apply. Decided by the coordinator on 2026-11-16 under delegated section authority: accepted as permissive, with the MIT and Zlib notices both retained. Zlib is not added to the allowlist. Reached from research-fixtures/canvas (no dev flag in the lockfile). Scope: research-only canvas fixture, not part of product distribution. This is not legal sign-off; re-review is required before any product distribution.

exceptions.name: robust-predicates
exceptions.reason: Unlicense: a public-domain dedication with no attribution obligation. Scope: research-only canvas fixture, not part of product distribution. This is not legal sign-off; re-review is required before any product distribution.
